title: Smart Data Models - Agrifood / AgriPlant
description: An individual plant (tree, vine or shrub) identified and located in the field and kept over time, for example a marked olive tree that is sampled every year. The plantation as a whole is described by AgriCrop and AgriParcel; AgriPlant does not replace them.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AgriPlant

location.description: GeoProperty. Position of the plant. Only Point is allowed: one entity per plant

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Parcel where the plant grows

hasAgriCrop.description: Relationship. Crop or plantation the plant belongs to. The plantation stays the unit of the crop cycle

agroVocConcept.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/URL'. The link to the species concept in the AgroVoc vocabulary

variety.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Variety or cultivar of the plant as named by the grower or nursery

plantCode.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Field label of the plant, unique within its parcel, for example the code on a physical tag

datePlanted.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Date when the plant was planted, if known

plantStatus.description: Property. Enum:'alive, dead, removed, replaced'. Current status of the individual plant

hasAgriPlantReplacement.description: Relationship. Plant that replaced this one. The new plant is a new entity, so the history of the old one is kept

height.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Height of the plant in meters

trunkPerimeter.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Perimeter of the trunk in meters, measured at the height given in trunkPerimeterHeight

trunkPerimeterHeight.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Height above the ground at which trunkPerimeter was measured, in meters

canopyDiameter.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Mean diameter of the canopy projection in meters

rowNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of the row where the plant stands, starting at 1

positionInRow.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Position of the plant within its row, starting at 1
